::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 16. 1867.  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1) P. 179
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	

[I](people/person_939.qmd)think I have got a most charming gem of Alexander, whom I was contemplating as one [vignette](organizations/other_167.qmd). I am afraid he was rather an unworthy in some ways. But who is always <u>worthy</u>.[^1] This face is so beautiful. It is engraved by Worship[?] from the Besborough [sic] Collection. You shall see it.

Very faithfully yours
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: CMY was compiling her *Book of Worthies*.
